verdict.rationale: Paddle's own docs describe sales-assisted invoicing: teams can draft and send invoices for subscriptions and collect payment manually instead of charging a card on file, and a subscription is created automatically once an invoice is issued. That covers the core 'send invoices' part of the story. The evidence never describes a hosted invoice page or an online pay link for those invoices. The dunning and Payment Recovery docs cover retries and failed-payment emails only for automatically-collected subscriptions, not reminders on issued invoices. missing for 10: evidence of a hosted invoice page with online payment, automatic reminders for unpaid manually-collected invoices, independent corroboration.
